description.p: Quadrature is a four-channel audio player designed for broadcast studios and DJ workflows. Each channel has independent transport, monitoring, and cue, with a SQLite-backed music library, real-time spectrum visualization, and PipeWire output.

ul.li: Four independent channels with PFL/cue monitoring
SQLite music library with full-text search
MusicBrainz metadata enrichment over the public REST API
AcoustID fingerprint matching (requires user-supplied API key)
Real-time FFT spectrum analyzer per channel

description.p: The Flatpak distribution targets casual users and small libraries. For studio deployments and large libraries (50,000+ tracks), see the native install path documented in the project README.
